lines.zh: 我一步步走进浅水，水只到腿。
lines.en: I wade into the shallows; the water only reaches my legs.

lines.zh: 我沿着河岸走，蹄子陷进泥里。
lines.en: I walk the bank; my hooves sink in mud.
I shift along, heavy-bodied.

lines.zh: 我走过的地方，草被压成一片。
lines.en: The grass flattens where I pass.

lines.zh: 我张开嘴，打了个很大的哈欠。
lines.en: I open my mouth in a huge yawn.
I lift a leg out of the water.
I take half a turn along the water's edge.
I wade into the mudflat, only my back showing.
I move slowly toward the far bank.

lines.zh: 我停在浅水里，水波一圈圈。
lines.en: I stop in the shallows; ripples spread.

lines.zh: 我头低着，鼻子贴近水面。
lines.en: Head low, my snout near the surface.

lines.zh: 我把身体横过来，挡住路。
lines.en: I turn sideways and block the way.
I step deeper.
I twitch my ears and walk on.
I open my mouth wide and close it slowly.
I hold still in the shallows.

lines.zh: 我的背浮在水面上，像块石头。
lines.en: My back floats like a stone.

lines.zh: 我抬头，鼻孔喷出一口气。
lines.en: I lift my head; my nostrils blow out a breath.
I sun my back on the bank.
I rest my chin at the water's edge.
I watch the water and do not move.
I shake my head and throw off water.
I sink until only my nose shows.

lines.zh: 我挪了挪脚，找了个稳的地方。
lines.en: I shift my feet to firmer ground.
I soak. No wish to climb out.
I turn my head slowly toward the bank.

lines.zh: 我又浮上一点，打了个响鼻。
lines.en: I rise a little and snort.
I settle down at the water's edge.
My teeth can be worked into a dagger.

lines.zh: 我把大嘴撑开，让你看牙。
lines.en: I open my huge mouth to show you my teeth.

lines.zh: 我在水里一步一步靠近。
lines.en: I come closer through the water.
You step back; I stop.
I raise my head level with yours.

lines.zh: 再退两步，我的领地到岸线。
lines.en: Two steps back; my territory ends at the shoreline.
I am not coming ashore.
I have your position.

lines.zh: 我喷出一口气，水面凹下去。
lines.en: I snort; the water's surface dips.
I sink back a little.
I give half a step; ripples spread.
I lower my bulk.
I ease back into the water.

lines.zh: 水珠和血一起甩到岸上。
lines.en: Water and blood spray onto the bank.

lines.zh: 厚皮下的伤，让我喷出白气。
lines.en: The wound under thick hide makes me snort white mist.
I lower my head to the wound.

lines.zh: 只把鼻孔留在水面，我躲。
lines.en: I leave only my nostrils above water and hide.
I move toward the far bank.

lines.zh: 咬空了，我只咬到一嘴泥。
lines.en: I bite air and get a mouthful of mud.

lines.zh: 这样的东西不合我的口味。
lines.en: Things like this do not suit my taste.
I sniff. No interest.
You set it on the bank. I do not go.
I shove it back toward you.
That mouthful is not enough.

lines.zh: 那点草不够，我退回深水。
lines.en: That bit of grass isn't enough; I retreat to deep water.
I glance at the far bank.
I settle lower into the water.
By the water, my temper is short.

lines.zh: 我被撞得歪了歪，水波散开。
lines.en: I rock; ripples spread.

lines.zh: 你踩进泥里，脚陷下去了。
lines.en: You step in the mud and sink.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，我比你重得多。
lines.en: We collide. I am far heavier.
I rear up and push you clear.
I slowly turn my back.
I am not cross at all.
I shift my bulk aside a little.

lines.zh: 你撞进泥里，河水一下变褐。
lines.en: You crash into the mud; the river turns brown.
Another swims over from the far bank.
We soak side by side.
I rest my head against its back.

lines.zh: 它打了个响鼻，我回了一声。
lines.en: It snorts; I answer.
We climb out and walk together.
Its body is wider than mine.

lines.zh: 我们一起在泥滩上趴着。
lines.en: We settle together on the mudflat.

lines.zh: 它把下巴搁在我的背上。
lines.en: It rests its chin on my back.

lines.zh: 我们一起下水，水漫上来。
lines.en: We enter the water and it rises around us.
We have not parted before dark.

lines.zh: 河水从我的牙上滴下来。
lines.en: River water drips off my teeth.
I push it into the river.
Too hard. I cannot chew it.
This holds no interest for me.

lines.zh: 我用前蹄踩住，谁也拿不走。
lines.en: I pin it under a forefoot; no one takes it.
It is tiny in my mouth.

lines.zh: 我一甩头，它飞进芦苇丛。
lines.en: One toss of my head sends it into the reeds.

lines.zh: 河边的草，我一口就收拾干净。
lines.en: The riverside grass, I'll clear it in one bite.
You have come near the water.

lines.zh: 我从水里立起，水滴成帘。
lines.en: I rise from the water, drops falling in curtains.
I step toward you.
The water parts around me.
I have noted the bank where you stand.

lines.zh: 河马的嘴，一张开就没边。
lines.en: A hippo's mouth opens without limit.
Retreating up the bank will not help.

lines.zh: 我抬起前腿，泥水先压过来。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg; mud and water surge first.
I come out of the water step by step.

lines.zh: 你往左挪，我的大嘴跟着转。
lines.en: You shift left; my huge mouth turns with you.

lines.zh: 我踩在岸上，地面震了一下。
lines.en: I step onto the bank; the ground jumps.

lines.zh: 你砍下来，只留下一道白痕。
lines.en: You cut me and leave only a pale line.
I open my mouth wide and close it.
I let out no bellow at all.

lines.zh: 你退到泥里，走得更慢了。
lines.en: You back into the mud and slow down.
There are two steps between us.
I bite down. Heavy.

lines.zh: 我用身体撞你，水花四起。
lines.en: I ram you; water sprays.
I rear and come down.
I shove you into the water.

lines.zh: 我踩在你旁边，泥陷下去。
lines.en: I step beside you; the mud sinks.
You pull back; I come on.
I open my mouth at your arm.
My whole weight comes down.
I surface from the water.
I snort first.
I swim toward the bank.
I climb up through the river mud.

lines.zh: 我站稳，抖了抖身上的水。
lines.en: I steady and shake the water off.
I wade into the shallows.
I raise my head to the sun.
I have found a good spot.
I begin grazing slowly.
I step once more into the water.
I will stay right here.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的背，我赶紧下水。
lines.en: Fire catches my back; I get into the water.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔下，砸进水里。
lines.en: I fall from the bank and crash into the water.
The water is too deep; I cannot find the bottom.
The blast flips me in the water.

lines.zh: 箭扎进我的厚皮，只进了一点。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my thick hide, barely in.

lines.zh: 那光钻进我的身体，很冷。
lines.en: That light gets into me, cold.

lines.zh: 饿得我连水都不想泡了。
lines.en: Too hungry even to soak.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面上，我整头麻了。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water; my whole head numbs.
The water is gone; I fall hard.
